status: development protocol after inspected v13 outcomes; no preregistration, independent validation or assured gain
inputs: Exactly unchanged v13 patient IDs, raw T, originaluHNDI and all12/16/16 new views. Common training-only feature median fill, all-empty0. No explicit missingness, demographics, manual labels or new exclusions. Same common filled inputs for backbone, adapted journal and classical comparators.
reference: Fit train median/IQR asinh anchor geometry for T/uHNDI. For each held-out query choose5nearest training patients by squared Euclidean distance in this geometry with stable input-order ties, replace each observed extra feature by the local observed-feature median, global train median if local missing. Unobserved query features keep the same global fill in actual and reference. Reference has identical T/uHNDI to actual. Neighbor choice receives no labels. This is a constructed statistical reference, not a causal counterfactual or a measurement of physiology.
predictor: One official local Nature-v2 TabPFN2.0.9 model context per inner/outer training fold, four ensemble members, seed outerseed+fold. Train on common real filled training inputs/labels; predict actual and reference separately using same fitted context. Backbone comparator uses precisely the same actual probability. No validation/test labels enter model or reference construction.
score: asinh(training-normalized fixed measurement_anchor)+eta*(p_MCS(actual)-p_MCS(reference)); eta in[0,.25,.5,1,2]. Absolute correction<=eta; anchor margins>2eta cannot reverse, no AUC guarantee.
anchor: T for Binder/Wielek, originaluHNDI for Mendeley, disclosed prior inspected-data choice fromv11; no anchor-selection gain credited as new information.
controls: posterior_fusion=anchor+eta*(2*p_actual-1), same eta grid; reference_only=anchor+eta*(2*p_reference-1), same eta grid. Official backbone comparator excludes the new anchor/witness combination. Classical and two journal adapters refit on identical full filled inputs with train-only preprocessing. Avoid giving the new combination credit for its borrowed predictor's existing ability.

tabpfn.exposure_limit: Upstream exposure cannot be independently exhaustively audited

etmc.groups: baseline2-column view and each of four frozenv13views; journal concatpseudo-view adaptation, not imagebackbone reproduction

roboss.limit: Paper objective/L-BFGS adaptation, not official NAG implementation or guaranteed global optimum

selection: Mean3-inner-fold AUC, ties1e-12 prefer smallereta/first listedcandidate. Cache the same fitted inner-fold predictor/probabilities across eta candidates; do not fit multiple contexts or average best seeds. Save candidate inner predictions and reference neighbor IDs for replay.
environment: Same isolated.local_deps sklearn1.6.1/tabpfn2.0.9, SCIPY_ARRAY_API=1 before imports; localcheckpoint/device, globalsunchanged. Hash package code/checkpoint and freeze protocol/code before outerpredictions.
metric: Mean outer-fold AUC then5-seedmean andequalcohortmacro; everymethod/seed retained, no sign inversion or bestseed headline.
performance_target: Positive macro deltas vs T and originaluHNDI at eachseed, positive5-seed mean vsboth in eachcohort, positive macro mean vs measurement_anchor, officialTabPFN, posterior_fusion and reference_only. Also report all same-input recent/classical comparisons; no superiority over methods with better reported results.
novelty_limit: Candidate reference-query probability contrast combined with a strong anchor. Constituent methods borrowed/disclosed, no priority claim, clinical validity, rawgaininvariance or causality assertion. Repeated adaptive inspection of these cohorts requires future independent confirmation.
protection: Read-only completed oldresults, sourceaudit, manuscript and code. v13recentcomparisons with v10inputs are not reused as new predictions. Failed dependencies stop with precise failure, no proxy substitutes.
